initialExam.title: HPPSC HAS 2026 (Himachal Pradesh Administrative Service)
initialExam.description: Himachal Pradesh Administrative Service examination for recruitment to Group A and Group B posts in HP state government and allied services.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: General Studies, Aptitude Test. Mains: Hindi, English, Essay, General Studies, Optional.
initialExam.jobRole: HAS Officer, HP Police Service, Block Development Officer
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit hppsc.hp.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LTC, Government quarters, Pension
